mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cs_return_record ( return_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, order_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, reason TEXT, status VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cs_return_record(return_id, order_id, reason, status) VALUES (#{returnId}, #{orderId}, #{reason}, #{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_id = VALUES(order_id), reason = VALUES(reason), status = VALUES(status)
mapper.select: SELECT return_id, order_id, reason, status FROM cs_return_record WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY return_id LIMIT 1
